status: Retained shared hierarchy traversal for physics sync; F8 open
change: Gather Parent/Children through a shared ECS query view and insert live descendants into the affected set. Initial roots are already present and no longer reinserted. Empty candidate sets skip the view.
semantics: Visit children even when already affected, reject stale descendants, and preserve final entity-ordered updates. Read borrow ends before ECS ownership changes. No new API, persistent cache, unsafe code or reduced gameplay workload.

focused.scope: Mac release, 5000 moving/rotating colliders, 20 warmup and 60 measured syncs

native.scope: Mac native-only dense-5000, 40 warmup and 300 measured ticks per mode, no renderer/Dart/catch-up

validation.clippy: release all targets, warnings denied: passed
validation.iosRelease: built, installed, live verification complete, exact PIDs stopped
validation.regression: Changing a root body and an already-affected non-physics middle node still reaches the untouched grandchild collider; attachment and effective placement follow body add/remove/add. Direct sync assertions use parent-relative placement because Rapier updates its cached collider world pose during its solver step.

limitations: Sequential eight-second phone runs are diagnostics, not sustained FPS qualification.
Phone summary values are medians of per-frame window p50s, not per-tick values or pooled percentiles.
Native benchmark compares profiled/unprofiled outcomes within runs, not cross-build state equivalence.
Mac CPU improvement does not imply equivalent improvement in displayed FPS.
